Progress at origin/main@88c90f8b5abf4a80be3b1289d7719d6e03e29684:
- Confirmed the uv mismatch remains reproducible on main and added evidence to existing bug foliated-correct-arcticfox; no duplicate.
- The four inherited async review jobs were stale-running. Restarted autositic-scarlet-clam, couped-parttime-nag, sphalerite-bereft-tortoise, and priceless-hotheaded-annelid against origin/main; no duplicate runs.
- A claim attempt for certified leaf cordial-vulpine-piglet made no state change because parent written-peerless-kusimanse is unsigned. This confirms leaves must all be certified before story/epic certification and parent-first execution.
- audit_subdivine_zebraic repaired four leaves: 72 paths, 185 allowlisted blocks, 20 DD commands, strict readback clean.
- Root audited florid-gelatinous-doe: 38 blocks / 18 byte-stable paths; replaced its generic plan, exact impacts, and seven-command verification contract. It remains open/unassigned/unsigned pending independent audit and review.
- MCP show/status calls continued to queue behind gates; local read-only CLI fallback confirmed the same stale attestations. Existing MCP bug skaldic-carbon-copperhead covers this behavior.
